title: Emrys and the Veil
author: Kestrel Quintana
blurb: Tamsin Okafor, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
